releaseNotes: v1.2.0 — Adds shareable Sumo UI links. Pass include_share_url=true on sumo_search or sumo_investigate to get a deep link with the query and exact time range frozen at search time. Recipient opens the link in their browser and sees the same investigation context. Also adds sumo_admin actions share_last and share_history to retrieve share URLs after a search. Fully additive — existing usage is unchanged.
